result.instructions:
Grain Controller MCP workflow guide:
1. Everyday task operations have dedicated compact tools -- prefer these first:
   - grain_list_tasks(repo?, state?, q?, limit?, summary?) to browse tasks (compact summary rows by default).
   - grain_get_task(id, view?) to inspect one task (~1 KB "summary" by default, "conversation" to page comments, "full" for raw JSON).
   - grain_filing_context(repo?) to read target repositories, templates, boards, custom fields, and grantable capabilities before filing work.
   - grain_submit_task(...) to file a task. approve defaults to false (filed as "proposed" awaiting human approval); only set approve=true when explicitly authorized.
2. All other Grain controller operations (a few hundred routes across CI, merge queue, repos, releases, schedules, templates, settings, secrets, capabilities, deployment) use progressive discovery:
   - Call grain_explore_scope() with no arguments to list the scope groups you are authorized to use.
   - Call grain_explore_scope(scope="<group>", tool="<word>") (e.g. scope="tasks", tool="comment") to get the exact JSON input schemas of just the routes you need; a whole group (scope alone) can run to tens of KB, so name the tool whenever you know what you are after.
   - Call grain_invoke(tool="api_...", arguments={...}, reason?="...") to execute an authorized route.
3. Safety & authorization rules:
   - Destructive (DELETE) and dangerous-scope routes require a non-empty reason explaining why the change is being made.
   - Task mutations accept arguments.expect ({state?, title_prefix?, kind?}): the call reads the task first and refuses, changing nothing, if the record disagrees.
   - Calls run under your authenticated identity (and X-Grain-Acting-Task grants when present); if a scope is refused, ask a human to grant api:<scope> rather than working around it.

tools.description: List authorized Grain controller API scope groups, or return domain guidance and JSON input schemas for one scope group or scope -- narrowed to the routes whose tool name or path matches tool, when given.

scope.description: Optional scope group (e.g. 'tasks', 'ci', 'merge', 'repos', 'settings') or exact scope (e.g. 'ci:read'). Omit to list all authorized scope groups.

tool.description: Optional route tool name (e.g. 'api_add_comment') or a word of it or of its path (e.g. 'comment'): only matching routes' schemas are returned, which is far cheaper than a whole group's. With scope, searches that group; alone, every authorized route.

tools.name: grain_explore_scope

tools.description: Execute an authorized Grain controller API route discovered via grain_explore_scope.

arguments.description: Route arguments: path parameters by name, optional 'query' object, optional 'body' object (or flat body fields), and optional 'expect' task-state guard.

reason.description: Audit reason required for destructive (DELETE) and dangerous-scope routes.

tools.name: grain_invoke

tools.description: Return target repositories, templates, boards, custom fields, and grantable capabilities needed before calling grain_submit_task.

repo.description: Optional owner/name repository filter for templates and repo details.

tools.name: grain_filing_context

tools.description: File a new Grain task through POST /api/tasks. approve defaults to false (files as 'proposed' awaiting human approval).

approve.description: When true, queue the task immediately for dispatch (requires human caller or tasks:admin). Defaults to false ('proposed').

auto_merge.description: Enable auto-merge on green CI (person callers only; agents cannot enable auto-merge).

base.description: Base branch to work from (defaults to the repository's default branch).

capabilities.description: Explicit capability IDs for the task (omit to use deployment defaults).

custom_fields.description: Declared custom field values keyed by field name.

depends_on.description: Task IDs that must finish before this task dispatches.

description.description: Detailed task specification with enough context for an unattended sandbox run.

fields.description: Template input field values keyed by field name.

interactive.description: File as a live interactive chat task.

model.description: Optional model ID override from grain_filing_context.

no_repo.description: Set true to explicitly file a standalone task with no repository.

priority.description: Positive dispatch priority (default 5; higher numbers dispatch first).

reads.description: Additional owner/name repositories the task may read.

reason.description: Optional audit reason when filing with dangerous/admin escalations.

title.description: Short imperative task title (required unless template_id supplies one).

writes.description: Additional {repo, base} write targets for follow-up proposals.

tools.name: grain_submit_task

tools.description: List Grain tasks via GET /api/tasks with compact summary rows by default.

limit.description: Maximum number of tasks to return (default 50).

summary.description: Return compact summary rows without full descriptions (default true).

tools.name: grain_list_tasks

tools.description: Read one Grain task via GET /api/tasks/{id}. Defaults to a compact ~1 KB 'summary' view; pass view='conversation' to page comments or view='full' for raw TaskDetail JSON.

after.description: For view='conversation': return comments with ID > after (omit or -1 for the first page).

view.description: Output view: 'summary' (~1 KB default), 'conversation' (paged comments), or 'full' (complete JSON).

result.instructions:
Grain Controller MCP workflow guide:
1. Everyday task operations have dedicated compact tools -- prefer these first:
   - grain_list_tasks(repo?, state?, q?, limit?, summary?) to browse tasks (compact summary rows by default).
   - grain_get_task(id, view?) to inspect one task (~1 KB "summary" by default, "conversation" to page comments, "full" for raw JSON).
   - grain_filing_context(repo?) to read target repositories, templates, boards, custom fields, and grantable capabilities before filing work.
   - grain_submit_task(...) to file a task. approve defaults to false (filed as "proposed" awaiting human approval); only set approve=true when explicitly authorized.
2. All other Grain controller operations (a few hundred routes across CI, merge queue, repos, releases, schedules, templates, settings, secrets, capabilities, deployment) use progressive discovery:
   - Call grain_explore_scope() with no arguments to list the scope groups you are authorized to use.
   - Call grain_explore_scope(scope="<group>", tool="<word>") (e.g. scope="tasks", tool="comment") to get the exact JSON input schemas of just the routes you need; a whole group (scope alone) can run to tens of KB, so name the tool whenever you know what you are after.
   - Call grain_invoke(tool="api_...", arguments={...}, reason?="...") to execute an authorized route.
3. Safety & authorization rules:
   - Destructive (DELETE) and dangerous-scope routes require a non-empty reason explaining why the change is being made.
   - Task mutations accept arguments.expect ({state?, title_prefix?, kind?}): the call reads the task first and refuses, changing nothing, if the record disagrees.
   - Calls run under your authenticated identity (and X-Grain-Acting-Task grants when present); if a scope is refused, ask a human to grant api:<scope> rather than working around it.

tools.description: List authorized Grain controller API scope groups, or return domain guidance and JSON input schemas for one scope group or scope -- narrowed to the routes whose tool name or path matches tool, when given.

scope.description: Optional scope group (e.g. 'tasks', 'ci', 'merge', 'repos', 'settings') or exact scope (e.g. 'ci:read'). Omit to list all authorized scope groups.

tool.description: Optional route tool name (e.g. 'api_add_comment') or a word of it or of its path (e.g. 'comment'): only matching routes' schemas are returned, which is far cheaper than a whole group's. With scope, searches that group; alone, every authorized route.

tools.name: grain_explore_scope

tools.description: Execute an authorized Grain controller API route discovered via grain_explore_scope.

arguments.description: Route arguments: path parameters by name, optional 'query' object, optional 'body' object (or flat body fields), and optional 'expect' task-state guard.

reason.description: Audit reason required for destructive (DELETE) and dangerous-scope routes.

tools.name: grain_invoke

tools.description: Return target repositories, templates, boards, custom fields, and grantable capabilities needed before calling grain_submit_task.

repo.description: Optional owner/name repository filter for templates and repo details.

tools.name: grain_filing_context

tools.description: File a new Grain task through POST /api/tasks. approve defaults to false (files as 'proposed' awaiting human approval).

approve.description: When true, queue the task immediately for dispatch (requires human caller or tasks:admin). Defaults to false ('proposed').

auto_merge.description: Enable auto-merge on green CI (person callers only; agents cannot enable auto-merge).

base.description: Base branch to work from (defaults to the repository's default branch).

capabilities.description: Explicit capability IDs for the task (omit to use deployment defaults).

custom_fields.description: Declared custom field values keyed by field name.

depends_on.description: Task IDs that must finish before this task dispatches.

description.description: Detailed task specification with enough context for an unattended sandbox run.

fields.description: Template input field values keyed by field name.

interactive.description: File as a live interactive chat task.

model.description: Optional model ID override from grain_filing_context.

no_repo.description: Set true to explicitly file a standalone task with no repository.

priority.description: Positive dispatch priority (default 5; higher numbers dispatch first).

reads.description: Additional owner/name repositories the task may read.

reason.description: Optional audit reason when filing with dangerous/admin escalations.

title.description: Short imperative task title (required unless template_id supplies one).

writes.description: Additional {repo, base} write targets for follow-up proposals.

tools.name: grain_submit_task

tools.description: List Grain tasks via GET /api/tasks with compact summary rows by default.

limit.description: Maximum number of tasks to return (default 50).

summary.description: Return compact summary rows without full descriptions (default true).

tools.name: grain_list_tasks

tools.description: Read one Grain task via GET /api/tasks/{id}. Defaults to a compact ~1 KB 'summary' view; pass view='conversation' to page comments or view='full' for raw TaskDetail JSON.

after.description: For view='conversation': return comments with ID > after (omit or -1 for the first page).

view.description: Output view: 'summary' (~1 KB default), 'conversation' (paged comments), or 'full' (complete JSON).

tools.name: grain_get_task
